confidence_notes: I ran two web searches: one for the RBA rate and one for Amritsar food and drink prices. The food and drink figures come from crowdsourced aggregates (Numbeo, Citycost, Expatistan) and vary between sources. Beer, coffee and meal anchors are based on those. Cocktail and wine are weakly sourced. I set them from a typical price relationship to beer, with a premium for the limited number of licensed bars. Accommodation anchors are holistic model estimates, not checked against any listings. The FX rate is the RBA's official 4 pm figure for 18 November 2026. A 19 November table value of 0.6677 may be provisional.
comparable_city_reasoning: Based on Amritsar's own crowdsourced price data. Accommodation is compared with other mid-sized North Indian pilgrimage and tourism cities such as Varanasi and Rishikesh, with a Golden Temple demand premium.
